# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

### How Omega-3 Free Fatty Acids Improve Absorption

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,
the form that is absorbed most efficiently.
[Read Article][123]

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine
supplementation, providing a safe and reliable source of iodine ions for a wide range of nutritional
applications.
[Read Article][124]

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and
reliable performance for flexible packaging applications.
[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

What is DMAA? Learn how N,N-dimethylacetoacetamide functions as a resin copromoter and chemical
intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.
[Read Article][128]

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!
[Read Article][129]

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

# Welcome to Brenntag

Brenntag is the global market leader in full-line range of chemical & ingredient products and
value-added services.
Our more than 17,300 employees provide tailor-made application, marketing and supply chain

# Leading Importer, Distributor & Manufacturer’s
# Representative in India for chemicals.

# Centred on Innovative Solutions, Value-Addition & Commitment.

# Strong Sourcing Expertise & excellent Relationship with Global Chemical Manufacturers.

# Strong experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Import & Export of wide array of Chemicals.

### Introduction

Incorporated in 1991 by Mr. Jiten Dadia, Venus International is a Mumbai, India based organization
engaged in Import and Distribution of a range of speciality chemicals from Internationally reputed
sources. Blending together a wide base of knowledge along with years of experience, we are a
one-stop shop for all your Chemical requirements. Our products have cross-industry applications in
the fields of Dyes & Pigments, Pharmaceuticals & Bulk Drug intermediates, Agro-Chemicals, Paints &
Coatings, Lubricants, Greases & Metal-Working Fluids, Home & Personal Care Products, Adhesives,
Resins & Plasticizers, Plywood & Laminates, Rubber & Electronics, Aromatics, Textile Auxiliaries,
Food and Flavours, Specialty Chemicals & other related Industries. We represent highly reputed
global chemical manufacturers from India and overseas.

Our avant-garde set up in Santacruz, Mumbai is well equipped to handle large scale transactions of
chemicals. A highly qualified management team under the aegis of Mr. Jiten Dadia forms the crux of
the company with a high level of knowledge on the subject matter. The company has access to skilled
engineers, technical experts and other resources handling operations, packaging & logistics as per
requirement. We believe in a no-compromise policy on Quality Assurance, Quality Control & EHS
(Environmental Health & Safety) factors

[Image ]

### Vision

To create business value by supplying exceptional range of chemicals of Internationally approved
quality for our clients, blended with immaculate pre sales support and post sales service.

### Mission

To cater the increasing demands of chemical consumers with ethical business practices, wide-range of
innovative products, timely delivery and competitive prices thereby rendering support for prolonged
business relations.

### Values
* Safe business conduct
* Ethics and Integrity
* Strict observance of regulatory and legal requirements
* Respecting diverse perspectives

# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize

maintenance interval.

flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

## Our Purpose

At CGAA, we encourage exploration through questions. Unravel new passions and interests effortlessly
with our endless directory of answers, covering working conditions, the new york times, credit
bureau, and more.

Our free tool is designed for anyone curious and eager to learn, offering quick, well-researched
answers while organizing topics into clear categories for easy exploration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What is CGAA?

A. CGAA is a directory driven by a community of experts. We find answers to the commonly asked
questions on the internet. In collaboration with our users, we identify unanswered questions,
helping people find the information they need.

Q. What topics does CGAA cover?

A. Our topics include working conditions, the new york times, credit bureau, economic policy, and
social programs. We are constantly expanding our selection. Have an idea for a category? Please
[contact us][60].

Q. Who is this for?

A. CGAA is a free tool for curious minds and anyone seeking knowledge.

Q. Can I advertise on CGAA?

A. As a directory driven by a community of experts, we welcome advertisers who can enhance the
experience for our users. If you're interested in featuring your brand in a CGAA article, please
[reach out][61] to our team.

with our endless directory of answers, covering working conditions, the new york times, credit
bureau, and more.

Our free tool is designed for anyone curious and eager to learn, offering quick, well-researched
answers while organizing topics into clear categories for easy exploration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What is CGAA?

A. CGAA is a directory driven by a community of experts. We find answers to the commonly asked
questions on the internet. In collaboration with our users, we identify unanswered questions,
helping people find the information they need.

Q. What topics does CGAA cover?

A. Our topics include working conditions, the new york times, credit bureau, economic policy, and
social programs. We are constantly expanding our selection. Have an idea for a category? Please
[contact us][60].

Q. Who is this for?

A. CGAA is a free tool for curious minds and anyone seeking knowledge.

Q. Can I advertise on CGAA?

A. As a directory driven by a community of experts, we welcome advertisers who can enhance the
experience for our users. If you're interested in featuring your brand in a CGAA article, please
[reach out][61] to our team.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI

  **Acid Gas Removal**
  
  Acid gas removal eliminates acid gases from hydrocarbon streams such as natural gas, natural gas
  liquids (NGLs), and hydrogen streams. Typically, acid gas refers to hydrogen sulfide and carbon
  dioxide, but an acid gas is any similar contaminant that must be removed from a hydrocarbon stream
  (mercaptans, carbonyl sulfide, carbon disulfide, carbon monoxide, etc). Acid gas must be removed
  prevent corrosion, improve process efficiency, prevent hydrate formation, and ensure the product
  meets pipeline and sales specifications.

value-added services.

Henan GP Chemicals Co.,Ltd

Henan GP Chemicals Co.,Ltd and it's brother company Henan EME Technology Co.,Ltd and DEXI CHEMICALS
CO.,LIMITED are the professional and comprehensive distributor of chemical products in China. the
company provides business-to-business distribution solutions for industrial and specialty chemicals
globally. With over 1,000 products and a highly diverse supplier base, GP CHEMICALS offers
one-stop-shop solutions to about 2,000 customers in worldwide. GP Chemicals is one of the leading
ketones, acetates, amines, glycol ethers, arylates, tertiary butyl acetate, tetrahydrofuran, TDI,
acetonitrile, N-Methyl pyrrolidone, methyl-1, 3-propanediol(MPO), PTMEG, PBT suppliers and also a
professional such manufacturer in China. Welcome to buy bulk chemical products from us.

GP Chemicals purchases and stores large-scale quantities of industrial and specialty chemicals from
various suppliers. With value-added services such as just-in-time delivery, product mixing,
formulation, repackaging, inventory management, drum return handling as well as technical services,
GP CHEMICALS aims to be the partner of choice for our customers and suppliers.

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

[ Get Started ][62]

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

[ Learn about Owler Pro ][63]

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

## Join leading brands getting better business insights with Owler

### Over 300 Years of Combined Experience with Plastic Additives

Performance Additives was formed in 2005 with the goal of providing North American plastics
processors with quality plastic additives backed by support, testing, and service of a North
American organization.  Performance Additives leverages our global technology, diverse product
portfolio, competitive pricing and knowledge to deliver a value added package of plastic additives
to North American customers.

Our company offers unique PVC additives, many not currently offered by North American manufacturers.
Including:

Acrylic Impact Modifiers & Processing Aids
CPE & ACM Impact Modifiers
MBS Impact Modifiers
SAN Processing Aids & ABS Impact Modifiers
Heat Distortion Additives

### Expertise

[Technical Resources][43]

Performance Additives employs industry professionals who have considerable experience up and down
the supply chain for PVC compounding and processing. This allows us to better understand our
customer’s challenges and provides a holistic perspective on how to solve them with our unique
chemistries.
* Formulation Development
* Material Convey/Storage/Collection
* Process and Equipment

[Read More ][44]

[Lab Resources][45]

In 2016 Performance Additives established a technical lab in Johnson City, Tennessee. We want to be
your go to supplier when looking at new product development and encourage you to reach out to us for
formulation ideas and the use of our lab equipment.

If you have some quality or product development issues you are trying to solve, Performance
Additives can brainstorm and implement testing to help you to find the best path forward.

[Read More ][46]

[Customer Service][47]

Performance Additives provides strong service and support for the supply of raw materials in the
North American market. Our dedicated and reliable customer service staff will meet your delivery
requirements and will adapt, as needed, to changes in day–to-day business.

[Read More ][48]

[Logistics][49]

Our logistics team has an extensive understanding of our global supply chain. This enables us to
offer timely and flexible deliveries to meet our customer’s needs. Performance Additives offers five
strategically located full-service warehouses that are routinely stocked to meet our customer’s
expected demand, with room for continued growth.

[Read More ][50]

railing, foam sheets and so much more. If you’re looking for a PVC additives supplier for the

### HOW CAN I FIND BUSINESS PARTNERS AND BE IN THE KNOW ON INDUSTRY INTELLIGENCE?

SOCMA’s commercial network helps you find the right connections to develop partnerships with
contract manufacturers and customers. We are your bridge to finding suppliers and customers through
our lead sheet services, and we are your source of intelligence for end-market insights and product
applications. Our ChemSectors network provides the industry intelligence to make key business growth
decisions.

[grow your business][54]

### What resources will help me strengthen my operations, train my employees and improve safety?

Our compliance and stewardship programs promote and guide the implementation of safe, sustainable
and environmentally responsible operations across the supply chain.

[discover your resources][55]

### Where can I get intel on the latest regulations and policy specifically impacting specialties?

We are a powerful industry advocate. Our regulatory and legislative programs ensure you are always
at the forefront of any issues or policies that may impact the way you do specialty chemistry.

[find policy solutions][56]

### WHERE CAN I GAIN TARGETED ACCESS TO THE SPECIALTY CHEMICAL INDUSTRY FOR MY TALENT POOL?

SOCMA’s Career Center is the only one-stop shop for talent management and career resources for the
chemical industry. By using the Career Center, your available positions are advertised to a
segmented audience in the chemistry space, delivering better candidates and results.

[build your workforce][57]

## Discover Our Community

SOCMA provides invaluable access to key decision makers from hundreds of specialty chemistry
companies. Let us help you achieve your business objectives faster and more efficiently.

[Become a member][58]

### IN THE NEWS

July 20, 2026

#### [Raising the Bar: The Evolution of SOCMA’s Safety Recognition Program][59]

As part of our commitment to advancing safety performance across the industry, we are introducing
enhancements to the 2026 Safety Recognition Program that will place greater emphasis on performance,
proactive safety efforts, and continuous improvement.
[Read more][60]
June 8, 2026

#### [Solutions for Specialties: Showcasing the Value of SOCMA Membership][61]

The specialty chemical industry continues to face a complex operating environment marked by
regulatory uncertainty, evolving policy priorities, supply chain pressures, and workforce
challenges. In times like these, companies should be leaning into their trade association
to access timely information, industry expertise, and a strong network. 
[Read more][62]
May 13, 2026

#### [SOCMA Board Advocates for Domestic Manufacturing, Supply Chain Resilience on Capitol Hill][63]

The Society of Chemical Manufacturers & Affiliates (SOCMA) this week is bringing specialty chemical
industry leaders to Washington, D.C., for a series of meetings with lawmakers, federal agencies, and
policymakers focused on strengthening U.S. manufacturing competitiveness, improving regulatory
certainty, and reinforcing domestic supply chains.
[Read more][64]

# It's all about the chemistry®


At SONGWON, we understand the challenges our customers encounter on a daily basis and what they
require to meet the demands of their various industries. We strive to provide chemical solutions
that give them a competitive edge. As a leading global chemical company our highly advanced
production processes and technology can tailor our [additives and specialty chemicals][53] to
specification.

## Our business units

SONGWON, the second largest manufacturer & supplier of polymer stabilizers in the world, offers a
very broad range of specialty chemicals. We provide chemical products for a wide variety of sectors
& industries, including the packaging, automotive, building & construction, agriculture, textiles
and fibers, coatings, adhesives, durable & consumer goods, lubricants, and electric and electronic
industries.

Fuel and Lubricant Additives

Additives are essential for lubrication and prolonged use of oil in engines and gearboxes.
Antioxidants retard oxidation by reacting with the radicals produced in the engine oil and extend
drain intervals.

injection molding, extrusion, printing inks, flexible packaging and synthetic leather.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier

detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

## Our Purpose

At CGAA, we encourage exploration through questions. Unravel new passions and interests effortlessly
with our endless directory of answers, covering working conditions, the new york times, credit
bureau, and more.

Our free tool is designed for anyone curious and eager to learn, offering quick, well-researched
answers while organizing topics into clear categories for easy exploration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What is CGAA?

A. CGAA is a directory driven by a community of experts. We find answers to the commonly asked
questions on the internet. In collaboration with our users, we identify unanswered questions,
helping people find the information they need.

Q. What topics does CGAA cover?

A. Our topics include working conditions, the new york times, credit bureau, economic policy, and
social programs. We are constantly expanding our selection. Have an idea for a category? Please
[contact us][60].

Q. Who is this for?

A. CGAA is a free tool for curious minds and anyone seeking knowledge.

Q. Can I advertise on CGAA?

A. As a directory driven by a community of experts, we welcome advertisers who can enhance the
experience for our users. If you're interested in featuring your brand in a CGAA article, please
[reach out][61] to our team.

## Our Purpose

At CGAA, we encourage exploration through questions. Unravel new passions and interests effortlessly
with our endless directory of answers, covering working conditions, the new york times, credit
bureau, and more.

Our free tool is designed for anyone curious and eager to learn, offering quick, well-researched
answers while organizing topics into clear categories for easy exploration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What is CGAA?

A. CGAA is a directory driven by a community of experts. We find answers to the commonly asked
questions on the internet. In collaboration with our users, we identify unanswered questions,
helping people find the information they need.

Q. What topics does CGAA cover?

A. Our topics include working conditions, the new york times, credit bureau, economic policy, and
social programs. We are constantly expanding our selection. Have an idea for a category? Please
[contact us][60].

Q. Who is this for?

A. CGAA is a free tool for curious minds and anyone seeking knowledge.

Q. Can I advertise on CGAA?

A. As a directory driven by a community of experts, we welcome advertisers who can enhance the
experience for our users. If you're interested in featuring your brand in a CGAA article, please
[reach out][61] to our team.

  **Acid Gas Removal**
  
  Acid gas removal eliminates acid gases from hydrocarbon streams such as natural gas, natural gas
  liquids (NGLs), and hydrogen streams. Typically, acid gas refers to hydrogen sulfide and carbon
  dioxide, but an acid gas is any similar contaminant that must be removed from a hydrocarbon stream
  (mercaptans, carbonyl sulfide, carbon disulfide, carbon monoxide, etc). Acid gas must be removed
  prevent corrosion, improve process efficiency, prevent hydrate formation, and ensure the product
  meets pipeline and sales specifications.

# A sustainable future through innovative chemistry

##### Our vision is to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company

With a vision to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company, we deliver customer
value through innovative chemistry that supports the energy transition and drives sustainable
progress.

Our specialty chemicals reduce the impact of current transportation modes, enable e-mobility,
support decarbonisation, improve industrial efficiency and much more, helping our customers solve
complex challenges and succeed in a changing world.

### Customer Centric Innovation

We provide innovative solutions that solve the complex challenges faced by our customers today

[Explore our Customer Centric Innovation][48]

### Sustainability

Working with our value chain partners to achieve sustainability ambitions

[Learn about our Sustainability approach][49]

### Safety

Safety, Security and the Environment are our highest priorities

[Safety is our number one priority][50]

### Over 300 Years of Combined Experience with Plastic Additives

Performance Additives was formed in 2005 with the goal of providing North American plastics
processors with quality plastic additives backed by support, testing, and service of a North
American organization.  Performance Additives leverages our global technology, diverse product
portfolio, competitive pricing and knowledge to deliver a value added package of plastic additives
to North American customers.

Our company offers unique PVC additives, many not currently offered by North American manufacturers.
Including:

Acrylic Impact Modifiers & Processing Aids
CPE & ACM Impact Modifiers
MBS Impact Modifiers
SAN Processing Aids & ABS Impact Modifiers
Heat Distortion Additives

### Expertise

[Technical Resources][43]

Performance Additives employs industry professionals who have considerable experience up and down
the supply chain for PVC compounding and processing. This allows us to better understand our
customer’s challenges and provides a holistic perspective on how to solve them with our unique
chemistries.
* Formulation Development
* Material Convey/Storage/Collection
* Process and Equipment

[Read More ][44]

[Lab Resources][45]

In 2016 Performance Additives established a technical lab in Johnson City, Tennessee. We want to be
your go to supplier when looking at new product development and encourage you to reach out to us for
formulation ideas and the use of our lab equipment.

If you have some quality or product development issues you are trying to solve, Performance
Additives can brainstorm and implement testing to help you to find the best path forward.

[Read More ][46]

[Customer Service][47]

Performance Additives provides strong service and support for the supply of raw materials in the
North American market. Our dedicated and reliable customer service staff will meet your delivery
requirements and will adapt, as needed, to changes in day–to-day business.

[Read More ][48]

[Logistics][49]

Our logistics team has an extensive understanding of our global supply chain. This enables us to
offer timely and flexible deliveries to meet our customer’s needs. Performance Additives offers five
strategically located full-service warehouses that are routinely stocked to meet our customer’s
expected demand, with room for continued growth.

[Read More ][50]

At Performance Additives, we are a major supplier of additives into the PVC extrusion industry. All
of our additives used in this process help deliver the high quality products that shape our world
today.

Our PVC extrusion additives are typically found in water pipe, vinyl siding, fencing, decking,
railing, foam sheets and so much more. If you’re looking for a PVC additives supplier for the
extrusion industry you can count on, look no further.

[Read More ][52]

[icon] [

#### Injection Molding

][53]

Injection Molding is an extension of core competency in the extrusion process. For this reason, many
of the additives we sell into extrusion also flow into injection molding.

medical devices. No matter what your end product, Performance Additives is here to work alongside
you to help you achieve your goals.

### Over 300 Years of Combined Experience with Plastic Additives

Performance Additives was formed in 2005 with the goal of providing North American plastics
processors with quality plastic additives backed by support, testing, and service of a North
American organization.  Performance Additives leverages our global technology, diverse product
portfolio, competitive pricing and knowledge to deliver a value added package of plastic additives
to North American customers.

Our company offers unique PVC additives, many not currently offered by North American manufacturers.
Including:

Acrylic Impact Modifiers & Processing Aids
CPE & ACM Impact Modifiers
MBS Impact Modifiers
SAN Processing Aids & ABS Impact Modifiers
Heat Distortion Additives

### Expertise

[Technical Resources][43]

Performance Additives employs industry professionals who have considerable experience up and down
the supply chain for PVC compounding and processing. This allows us to better understand our
customer’s challenges and provides a holistic perspective on how to solve them with our unique
chemistries.
* Formulation Development
* Material Convey/Storage/Collection
* Process and Equipment

[Read More ][44]

[Lab Resources][45]

In 2016 Performance Additives established a technical lab in Johnson City, Tennessee. We want to be
your go to supplier when looking at new product development and encourage you to reach out to us for
formulation ideas and the use of our lab equipment.

If you have some quality or product development issues you are trying to solve, Performance
Additives can brainstorm and implement testing to help you to find the best path forward.

[Read More ][46]

[Customer Service][47]

Performance Additives provides strong service and support for the supply of raw materials in the
North American market. Our dedicated and reliable customer service staff will meet your delivery
requirements and will adapt, as needed, to changes in day–to-day business.

[Read More ][48]

[Logistics][49]

Our logistics team has an extensive understanding of our global supply chain. This enables us to
offer timely and flexible deliveries to meet our customer’s needs. Performance Additives offers five
strategically located full-service warehouses that are routinely stocked to meet our customer’s
expected demand, with room for continued growth.

[Read More ][50]

### Markets Served

[icon] [

#### Extrusion

][51]

At Performance Additives, we are a major supplier of additives into the PVC extrusion industry. All
of our additives used in this process help deliver the high quality products that shape our world
today.

Our PVC extrusion additives are typically found in water pipe, vinyl siding, fencing, decking,
railing, foam sheets and so much more. If you’re looking for a PVC additives supplier for the
extrusion industry you can count on, look no further.

[Read More ][52]

[icon] [

#### Injection Molding

][53]

Injection Molding is an extension of core competency in the extrusion process. For this reason, many
of the additives we sell into extrusion also flow into injection molding.

Injection molded articles go into a vast array of end products, from building and construction to
medical devices. No matter what your end product, Performance Additives is here to work alongside
you to help you achieve your goals.

[Read More ][54]

[icon] [

#### Calendering

][55]

The calendering process is a crucial process in the plastics industry that produces products like
credit cards and blister packs. At Performance Additives, our team offers not only standard
additives like MBS and acrylic impact modifiers, we are always working to develop the next
generation of calendering additives to help you stay efficient in an ever changing competitive
landscape.

[Read More ][56]

[icon] [

#### Custom One Packs

][57]

Performance Additives not only offers individual polymer solutions, we also offer unique products
that have been co-polymerized, co-sprayed, or physically blended. An example of this is an
ultra-high MW process aid co-spray dried with a low MW process aid, or an acrylic impact modifier
combined with a processing aid.

[Read More ][58]

# Your Trusted Partner in Chemical solutions

Your Trusted Partner in Chemical solutions Your Trusted Partner in Chemical solutions Your Trusted

Chemical distribution for all your business operations.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.
